subject: a small ruined stone shrine collapsed around a deep pond at night, the whole frame filled with broken walls and toppled pillars of plain smooth unmarked granite gone almost black with wet moss and shadow, roots and ferns prising the stones apart, seen from slightly above so the water fills the lower middle of the picture, the water itself black and depthless, and massed in it a shoal of large koi carp in vivid molten orange and burning vermilion, by far the brightest and most colourful thing in the picture, their colour smeared into long reflections across the black water, everything that is not a fish sunk in deep shadow
